# TF32 PV native block: all measured contexts

B1 Gemma12 block5; same NS33 and checkpoint; default scalar GF4, equal-arena scalar GF4, candidate GF16. Two process orders.

| Context | Order | Default us | Equal arena us | Candidate us | Gain vs default | Gain vs equal arena |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1024 | 0 | 300.87 | 307.10 | 316.38 | -5.16% | -3.02% |

| 8192 | 0 | 331.55 | 339.25 | 334.89 | -1.01% | 1.29% |
| 8192 | 1 | 329.79 | 340.13 | 333.96 | -1.26% | 1.81% |
| 32768 | 0 | 437.66 | 442.34 | 408.70 | 6.62% | 7.61% |

All short-window 13 jobs passed; 12 GPU processes. Original 32K six GPU processes passed, unchanged CPU validators required sudo only to write root-owned reports; original failures preserved.

40 iterations / 5 warmups; only median and p95 retained. 256 MiB eviction before each whole-step wall timer, not per-op cold. 1K regresses 5.06–5.16% and 8K regresses 1.01–1.26% against qualified default. Equal-arena comparison alone does not justify 8K advancement. Preserve scalar short-context control; the measured win is 32K only.

All context numerical gates and fresh 32K broad memory qualified at original thresholds. Candidate 251 registers, zero spills; both scalar controls 200 registers, zero spills. No full-model, serving, or vLLM claim.

 out=Path(j['output']);v=json.loads((out/'validation.json').read_text());assert v['passed']
 s=json.loads((out/'sweep.json').read_text())['sweep'];assert len(s)==1;s=s[0]
 assert s['decode_evict_bytes']==268435456 and s['decode_eviction_before_timer'] and s['decode_iterations']==40 and s['decode_warmup']==5
 rows.append(dict(arm=j['arm'],repeat=j['repeat'],context=j['context'],median_us=s['latency_us_median'],p95_us=s['latency_us_p95'],iterations_reported=40,warmup_reported=5,actual_duration_samples_retained=False))

 assert good

 # dmon pc: date,time,gpu,pwr,gtemp,mtemp,mclk,pclk
 samples=[dict(date=x[0],time=x[1],memory_mhz=int(x[-2]),sm_mhz=int(x[-1])) for x in good]
 assert {(x['memory_mhz'],x['sm_mhz']) for x in samples}=={(2619,1830)}
 assert len(partial)<=1 and (not partial or lines[-1]==partial[0])
 clocks.append(dict(job=j['name'],samples=samples,monitor_termination_partial_final_line=partial))
 files.extend([out/'validation.json',out/'sweep.json',Path(j['log']),dm])

res=dict(schema=1,passed=True,scope=old['scope'],decision='Retain 32K private native block win only. for ctx in [1024,8192,32768]:
 for rep in [0,1]:
  a={r['arm']:r for r in rows if r['context']==ctx and r['repeat']==rep};g=[r for r in pairs if r['context']==ctx and r['repeat']==rep]
  md.append(f"| {ctx} | {rep} | {a['default']['median_us']:.2f} | {a['control']['median_us']:.2f} | {a['candidate']['median_us']:.2f} | {g[0]['latency_reduction_percent']:.2f}% | {g[1]['latency_reduction_percent']:.2f}% |")

(p/'RESULTS.md').write_text('\n'.join(md)+'\n');files += [p/'RESULTS.json',p/'RESULTS.md',Path(__file__)]
(p/'FREEZE.json').write_text(json.dumps({str(f):hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in files},indent=2)+'\n')
